title: Approval record
description: The single shared approval record (standard 1.0.0) for every repository. It records a named human's decision on a subject, such as a recommendation, gate, go or no-go decision, credential grant, or appeal. The approver is always a human person. AI is never the approver. No repository defines a second approval schema. Examples are illustrative examples using synthetic data.

subject_type.description: Entity name of what is being approved, registered in standard/id-registry.yaml.

decision.description: The decided values of the recommendation vocabulary in standard/status-vocabularies.yaml.

approver_type.description: Always human. An approval record can never name an AI agent or a system as approver.

conditions.description: Conditions attached to an approval, if the owning workflow allows them.

source_repo.description: Repository whose workflow required this approval.

examples.reason: The draft cites a milestone date that the project record does not contain.
